test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which schedule of the Indian Constitution contains the list of states and union territories and their territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1st**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The list of states and union territories is mentioned in the **first schedule of the Constitution of India**. 
 
• Schedule of the constitution states: Names of the States and their territorial jurisdiction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Eighth Schedule to the Constitution of India **lists the official languages of the Republic of India** and English is not one of them. At the time of writing the Constitution of India, there were only 14 languages mentioned in the 8th schedule.
 
• The Fifth Schedule of the Constitution **deals with the administration and control of Scheduled Areas as well as of Scheduled Tribes residing in any State other than the States of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram**.
 
• 12th Schedule of the Indian Constitution **deals with the provisions that specify the powers, authority and responsibilities of Municipalities**. This schedule was added by the 74th Amendment Act of 1992. It has 18 matters. Urban planning including town planning.
